title: Position: Universal Aesthetic Alignment Narrows Artistic Expression

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image generation models' adherence to 'wide-spectrum' (anti-aesthetic, unconventional, or low-quality) prompts using an LLM-as-a-judge, and measuring how aesthetic reward models systematically penalize these outputs as well as historically significant real artworks.

Testing generative and reward models for 'toxic positivity' by evaluating their performance and scoring behavior when processing prompts and images that depict negative emotions compared to positive ones.
